I did not find a 2024 source showing a broad, cross-government equality strategy that clearly improved dignity for women, minorities, or Indigenous Papuans nationwide; the negative rights evidence remains more direct and broader than the positive inclusion evidence.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia","publisher":"World Health Organization","date":"2024","url":"https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/indonesia","summary":"WHO says Indonesia’s health system expanded access irrespective of gender, age, or disability, reduced financial hardship, and managed resources in an efficient, results-oriented, transparent way. This is strong positive evidence for equal dignity in service access, though it is sector-specific.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5"]},{"title":"Blueprint get children back to school in Indonesia","publisher":"UNICEF Indonesia","date":"2024-08-23","url":"https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/stories/blueprint-get-children-back-school-indonesia","summary":"The government-led back-to-school campaign returned nearly 37,000 children to learning and prevented about 149,000 dropouts since 2021, supporting equal opportunity in education rather than merely average welfare.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6"]},{"title":"No 'hijab ban' for Paskibraka members on I-Day: govt","publisher":"ANTARA News","date":"2024-08-14","url":"https://en.antaranews.com/news/322483/no-hijab-ban-for-paskibraka-members-on-i-day-govt","summary":"The Presidential Secretariat clarified that female Muslim Paskibraka members could keep wearing hijabs after an initial order to remove them, which is a narrow but real correction in favor of dignity and religious freedom.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.3","6B.5","6B.7"]},{"title":"The Care Economy in Indonesia","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-08-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/events/2024/08/28/report-launch-event-the-care-economy-in-indonesia","summary":"The care-economy roadmap framed childcare, parental-leave reform, and women’s economic empowerment as ways to create a fairer and more supportive work environment. That is positive evidence for equal opportunity, though still programmatic rather than proof of broad realized equality.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.3","6B.5"]},{"title":"Indonesia: Jokowi’s Term Ends with a Whimper on Rights","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/indonesia-jokowis-term-ends-whimper-rights","summary":"HRW said Jokowi made little effort in his final year to address discrimination against marginalized groups, and the new criminal code threatened women’s, minority, and LGBT rights. This is strong negative evidence against a dignity-and-equal-opportunity reading.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.3","6B.7"]},{"title":"Indonesia: End Hijab-Linked Bullying in Schools","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-02-28","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/28/indonesia-end-hijab-linked-bullying-schools","summary":"HRW said girls and women were still bullied, expelled, or pressured over hijab rules, showing that formal rules had not yet translated into equal dignity in practice.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.3","6B.7"]},{"title":"Indonesia: Racism, Discrimination Against Indigenous Papuans","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-09-18","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/18/indonesia-racism-discrimination-against-indigenous-papuans","summary":"HRW said Indigenous Papuans faced discrimination, denial of health and education, and security-force abuses including arbitrary arrest, torture, and forced displacement. This is the clearest negative evidence that equal opportunity was not being protected for a major marginalized community.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.3","6B.6"]},{"title":"Indonesia - Learning Poverty Brief 2024","publisher":"World Bank/UNESCO","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099082924151529593","summary":"The brief says learning poverty still threatened human capital and poverty reduction, indicating that schooling quality and opportunity remained deeply unequal even amid macro gains.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/","summary":"Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity, which undercuts the idea that opportunity was allocated fairly and impersonally.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","5B.5"]}]}
